description: Where is this address used? One call checks an EVM address on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon and BNB Chain: native balance, nonce (transactions sent), contract or EOA, EIP-7702 delegation, code size, and a per-chain active flag plus a summary of chains with activity. Useful before sending funds, for wallet screening and for picking the right chain. Keyless public RPC, read-only. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/evm-address-activity

address.description: EVM address (0x, 20 bytes; EIP-55 checked when mixed case)

chains.description: Subset of eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc (default all six)
